label: class_f_08_dragon_01
text: I do hope you’re all ready, because it is time for\nyour final exam! Focus and do your best![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_08_question_01
text:
1. What is the name of the restaurant where you
    can change a Pokémon’s Tera Type?

A) The Treasury
B) The Treasure Eatery
C) The Treasure Trove

text:

text:

text:

text:

label: class_f_08_dragon_03
text: Time’s up! That’s it for today’s test. Pencils down,\nplease.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_08_dragon_04
text: Thank you all so much for learning about art\nwith me![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_08_dragon_05
text: The time we shared has left a mark that I will\ntreasure, I promise you.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_08_dragon_06
text: And it is my sincere wish that all of you go on to\neven greater, more prosperous futures.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_08_dragon_07
text: And that’s that! Good work, everyone! You can\nreceive your results from the front desk.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
